code: # A link that fills the whole label, so that a click anywhere on it navigates nav_link <- function(to, label) {   NavLink(     to = to,     style = list(display = "block", color = "inherit", textDecoration = "none"),     label   ) }  page <- function(title, ...) {   Box(Typography(title, variant = "h5", gutterBottom = TRUE), ...) }  RouterProvider(   router = createMemoryRouter(     Route(       path = "/",       element = Paper(         variant = "outlined",         sx = list(display = "flex", minHeight = 260),         Box(           sx = list(width = 220, borderRight = 1, borderColor = "divider", p = 1),           SimpleTreeView(             defaultExpandedItems = list("components"),             defaultSelectedItems = "home",             TreeItem(itemId = "home", label = nav_link("/", "Home")),             TreeItem(               itemId = "components",               label = "Components",               TreeItem(itemId = "simple", label = nav_link("/simple-tree-view", "Simple Tree View")),               TreeItem(itemId = "rich", label = nav_link("/rich-tree-view", "Rich Tree View"))             ),             TreeItem(itemId = "about", label = nav_link("/about", "About"))           )         ),         Box(sx = list(p = 2, flexGrow = 1), Outlet())       ),       Route(         index = TRUE,         element = page("Home", Typography("Pick a page in the tree."))       ),       Route(         path = "simple-tree-view",         element = page("Simple Tree View", Typography("Items are TreeItem() children."))       ),       Route(         path = "rich-tree-view",         element = page("Rich Tree View", Typography("Items are data, built with asMuiTree()."))       ),       Route(         path = "about",         element = page("About", Typography("muiTreeView wraps MUI X Tree View for R."))       )     )   ) )

code: library(muiMaterial)  # Add a richer label to each package, group and function add_rich_label <- function(items) {   lapply(items, function(item) {     if (is.null(item$children)) {       row <- fns[fns$fn_id == item$id, ]       item$richLabel <- tags$code(paste0(row$package, "::", row$fn, "()"))     } else {       item$children <- add_rich_label(item$children)       n <- sum(fns$package == item$id | fns$group_id == item$id)       item$richLabel <- Stack(         direction = "row", spacing = 1, alignItems = "center",         Box(component = "span", item$label),         Chip(size = "small", variant = "outlined", label = paste(n, "functions"))       )     }     item   }) }  RichTreeView(   items = add_rich_label(fn_items),   defaultExpandedItems = list("muiCharts", "muiCharts-charts"),   slots = list(     item = JS("React.forwardRef(function RichLabelItem(props, ref) {       const { TreeItem, useTreeItemModel } = jsmodule['@mui/x-tree-view'];       const item = useTreeItemModel(props.itemId);       return React.createElement(TreeItem, { ...props, ref, label: item.richLabel });     })")   ) )

code: library(shiny) library(muiMaterial) library(muiTreeView)  to_id <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x))  fns <- rbind(   data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Layout", fn = c("Box", "Stack", "Grid")),   data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Inputs", fn = c("Button", "TextField", "Slider", "Switch")),   data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Navigation", fn = c("Link", "Tabs", "Drawer")),   data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Surfaces", fn = c("AppBar", "Toolbar", "Card")),   data.frame(package = "muiCharts", group = "Charts", fn = c("BarChart", "LineChart", "PieChart", "Gauge")),   data.frame(package = "muiCharts", group = "Building blocks", fn = c("ChartsContainer", "ChartsXAxis", "ChartsLegend", "Toolbar")),   data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Routers", fn = c("RouterProvider", "createHashRouter", "createMemoryRouter")),   data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Routes", fn = c("Route", "Outlet")),   data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Navigation", fn = c("Link", "NavLink", "Navigate")),   data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Hooks", fn = c("useParams", "useLoaderData", "useNavigate")) ) # Stable ids, built from the path: "Navigation", "Link" and "Toolbar" exist in two packages fns$group_id <- paste(fns$package, to_id(fns$group), sep = "-") fns$fn_id <- paste0(fns$package, "::", fns$fn)  fn_items <- asMuiTree(   fns,   levels = c("package", "group", "fn"),   levels_id = c("package", "group_id", "fn_id") )  ui <- muiMaterialPage(   CssBaseline(),   Stack(     direction = "row",     spacing = 2,     sx = list(p = 2),     Box(       sx = list(minWidth = 280),       RichTreeView(         items = fn_items,         checkboxSelection = TRUE,         multiSelect = TRUE,         selectionPropagation = list(descendants = TRUE, parents = TRUE),         defaultExpandedItems = list("muiCharts"),         onSelectedItemsChange = setInput("selected", 1)       )     ),     Box(tableOutput("table"))   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$table <- renderTable({     # Selecting a package or a group selects its functions, thanks to     # selectionPropagation; keep only the rows of the selected functions.     fns[fns$fn_id %in% input$selected, c("package", "group", "fn")]   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Theming
text: JS() code runs browser every visitor. pass fixed code ; never build string paste0() glue() user input, URL parameters, files databases. Put data items (arguments) read inside function, e.g. getItemLabel = JS("(item) => item.name"). embed values computed data, serialize jsonlite::toJSON(), escapes . Labels given plain strings escaped. Never wrap untrusted text HTML(), rendered markup. Values sent Shiny come browser can forged: see Shiny.
